gap: No result ChatGPT got states the maker's own pairing limits for the candidate batteries. Redodo says its 12V 100Ah Group 24 Bluetooth battery can be wired up to 4P4S (51.2 V × 400 Ah, 20.48 kWh) and is not for starting, golf carts or high-power loads such as water pumps. Sun Gold Power says its SG48100P 51.2 V 100 Ah rack battery talks CAN/RS485/RS232 to inverters from Growatt, Deye, SunGoldPower, Luxpower, Victron, Schneider, Phocos and SMK, and allows up to 63 units in parallel.
standout_why: Compared against cmxbattery.com (2026 compatibility guide), bluettipower.com (cited) and the 'Results it got' list. CMX names closed-loop brands and DIP codes, but only for its own CMX 48100 BMS. It covers none of Sun Gold Power, Redodo, Vatrer, WEIZE or ECO-WORTHY and gives no series or parallel limits for 12V drop-in batteries. BLUETTI's guide only lists which B300K/B500K expansion batteries fit which BLUETTI hosts. It says nothing about inverter protocols or series/parallel limits for standalone batteries. I could not read the cited savyenenergy.com page: WebFetch failed with a self-signed certificate error and curl needed approval I didn't have. So I can't rule out that Savyen covers part of this. That page is why the score is 2, not 3. None of the 17 results names a 12V drop-in battery's maximum series/parallel layout.
decides: This splits the pick by system type. To build a 48V bank from 12V drop-ins, Redodo caps it at four in series by four in parallel (20.48 kWh). Above that, or if you want the battery and inverter talking to each other (closed loop) on Growatt, Victron, Luxpower, Deye, Schneider or Sun Gold inverters, the SG48100P is the one whose maker names those brands. Sun Gold's own SGR-8K10E kit runs its 48V inverter with two SG48100P over RS485. For an all-Sun-Gold system, pairing the SG48100P with Sun Gold's inverters is the setup the maker itself documents.
